The people behind it

Two decades of teaching. A decade on the tools.

AOJ Service is led by founder Ajayi-Aribire Jeremiah, alongside co-founder Ajayi-Aribire Dasola. For twenty years Jeremiah has taught French and Yoruba and helped people publish their work; for ten he has run plumbing and facility projects across Ogun State.

It is an unusual pairing — and a deliberate one. The belief is simple: language and knowledge open doors, and well-kept spaces protect what people build behind them. AOJ Service does both, properly.

Jeremiah & Dasola Ajayi-AribireFounder & Co-founder, AOJ Service

Why AOJ Service

Reliable, certified, and easy to reach.

A trained French tutor and a certified facility-maintenance team — real qualifications behind both arms of the work.
